$comment: Custom ComfyUI nodes to provision. Each entry is git-cloned into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/<name> and checked out at the pinned ref. Update ref to bump a node. Run: npm run setup:comfyui-config

custom_nodes.$comment: PuLID (SDXL) identity reference — provides PulidModelLoader / PulidInsightFaceLoader / PulidEvaClipLoader / ApplyPulid used by the character-reference feature. Its requirements.txt (insightface, facexlib, onnxruntime, timm) is pip-installed by the provisioner. The SDXL weight (pulid_v1.1.safetensors) is a model file, not a node — fetch it with: npm run setup:pulid
custom_nodes.name: PuLID_ComfyUI
